# Aunt Jamesina

[Patty’s Place](../codex/places.md#patty-s-place)

## Overview

- **Nicknames:** Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P47](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0047), [v3 ch.Interlude P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** queen of housemothers  <sub>[v3 ch.Opens P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman with a small, softly-triangular face and pink cheeks. Her snow-white hair is styled in quaint little puffs over her ears. She also features large, soft blue eyes filled with an unquenchable youthfulness.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is an old-fashioned individual whose opinions and clothing reflect her traditional ways. She harbors a strong dislike for visiting others, yet she possesses a loving nature and maintains a proper respect for the clergy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Speaks P10](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0010), [v3 ch.Jonas P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

## History

Aunt Jamesina was named after her father, James, who drowned at sea a month before her birth. In her past, her mother and husband prevented her from wearing a yellow silk dress, and a former suitor never forgave her after she suggested he use a rubber band to train his ears. She raised a daughter who earned an M.A. after learning to cook, and though she prayed for her daughter to become a missionary, she ultimately wished she had not. Aunt Jamesina moved into Patty's Place to serve as an easygoing chaperone for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends, bringing along her pet, the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), which she had received as a gift from her washerwoman [Sarah](../character/sarah.md). During her time chaperoning, she conversed with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about growing up on Anne's twentieth birthday and offered advice when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discussed her options. She later welcomed the girls back to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), catching up with them as they unpacked.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +20 more_

## Quotes

> "She couldn’t take Joseph with her so she begged me to take him. I really couldn’t refuse. He’s a beautiful cat—that is, his disposition is beautiful. She called him Joseph because his coat is of many colors."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> “You go and get some fresh air,” repeated Aunt Jamesina, “but take your umbrella, for I believe it’s going to rain. I’ve rheumatism in my leg.”
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P8](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0008)
